info.name: Get summary stats for multiple advertisers

params.name: advertisers
params.description: Advertisers filter. Hash of advertiser. Multiple values may be concatenated using ",".

params.name: campaignType
params.description: Type of campaign to filter advertisers by. Advertisers belonging to different types cannot be fetched at once.

params.name: dayFrom
params.description: Date in format "YYYY-MM-DD".

params.name: dayTo
params.description: Date in format "YYYY-MM-DD".

params.name: groupBy
params.description: Stats grouping. Multiple values may be concatenated using "-". Not all combinations are possible.

params.name: metrics
params.description: Metrics to load. Multiple values may be concatenated using "-". Not all combinations are possible, availability depends on campaign type.

params.name: countConvention
params.description: Conversions counting convention. Required only if any conversion-related metrics is selected.

params.name: utcOffsetHours
params.description: UTC offset (in hours) for date range / time related dimensions.

params.name: currency
params.description: Currency to retrieve financial data in. Required only if advertisers with different native currencies are requested.

params.name: subcampaigns
params.description: Hash of subcampaign. Multiple values may be concatenated using "-".

params.name: userSegments
params.description: User segments filter. Multiple values may be concatenated using "-". Availability depends on campaign type.

params.name: deviceTypes
params.description: Device type filter. Only one device type allowed.
